gaps.evidence: Primary study used 20/30 ps according to supplied notes; no exact-material convergence study located
gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Primary PDF needed to confirm all runs and block-analysis details

gaps.evidence: No cell-size convergence study located; prior work did use disorder-representing supercells
gaps.distinctness: Question is convergence, not whether disorder was ignored
gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Exact original cell sizes and replicas require full text

gaps.evidence: Disorder was represented, but systematic ensemble sampling was not located
gaps.distinctness: Multiple Na2NbOF5 O/F configurations are system-specific
gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Full paper may contain more configuration sampling than accessible metadata shows

gaps.evidence: No exact-material Haven/collective study located; contextual Na MLIP study demonstrates relevance
gaps.distinctness: Applies correlation analysis to Na2NbOF5 rather than importing conclusions
gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Explicit treatment in primary paper must be confirmed from supplied PDF

gaps.evidence: Accessible exact-material AIMD evidence centers on 300 K; no long-trajectory temperature series located
gaps.distinctness: Long MLMD can estimate a material-specific Arrhenius regime
gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Confirm whether supplementary information contains additional temperatures

gaps.evidence: Prior screening addressed vacancy energetics and defect chemistry is not yet scoped well enough for a primary novelty claim
gaps.distinctness: Could become a secondary sensitivity study only after defect states are justified
gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Relevant intrinsic/extrinsic defect concentrations are unknown

surviving_gap: Whether Na2NbOF5 transport predictions converge with trajectory length and cell size across multiple O/F disorder realizations, and whether collective charge transport differs from tracer/Nernst–Einstein transport across temperature.
